_comment:
'If an Evo has been banished from boosting this turn, this gets +1{p}.' / '**Boost**' Mechanologist Action - Attack.

ABILITY TYPE settled by official_release_notes 1 ('generates a continuous effect that is always checking'): WHILE_STATIC re-evaluated on every RECALC_ATTACK_POWER dispatch - NOT a TRIGGERED ON_ATTACK form. Shape copied verbatim from SHIPPED evo/sprocket_rocket_blue.json (identical clause family, proves the spelling compiles) and matches .drafts/heavy_metal_hardcore_blue.json for the blue printing. MODIFY_ATTACK detects the recalculate_attack_power event and applies transiently in the stage-8 static window (effect_types.py:4137-4144, read this session), so repeated recalculations never stack the bonus.

BOOST_BANISHED_IS (condition_types.py:1147-1173, read this session) reads 'types' and matches each boost-banished card's types UNION subtypes via _norm, so 'Evo' hits the DB subtype. SOURCE_IS_ATTACK confines the pump to this card's own attack.

Printed **Boost** is in printed_keywords and fires from the card DB keywords field (ability_keywords.boost) - deliberately NOT authored; re-authoring a printed keyword is a defect. The +1{p} is a JSON-authored power bonus, not a conditional printed keyword, so no conditional-keyword strip is needed.

RESIDUAL NUANCE, disclosed: the printed text says 'banished from boosting this TURN', while the condition reads THIS card's own boost_banished record (boost() appends what it banished to the card it boosted) - an Evo banished by boosting a DIFFERENT attack earlier in the turn is invisible here. No precise wider scope is expressible today: OR-ing EVENT_THIS_TURN event='banish' qualifier='Evo' would also count Evos banished by costs or card effects that never boosted, which over-fires. Same treatment as shipped sprocket_rocket_blue/yellow. Release note 2 (a later boost on the same chain making the condition true without damage being recalculated) is engine recalc-timing behaviour, not something authoring can change.
